Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane at a traffic signal in Pasadena, Texas, when the vehicle behind them, operated
by Driver 2, failed to stop and struck the rear bumper of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front
passenger position at the time of impact. Passenger reported pain in the right knee and was able to step out of the
vehicle with some assistance and was transported for evaluation. The knee complaint is consistent with the force of a
rear impact of this kind, where an occupant's leg can strike the dashboard or lower console. Driver 2 acknowledged
the collision at the scene and did not dispute how it occurred. Two independent witnesses in a nearby vehicle gave
statements that matched the sequence described by both drivers, and scene photographs show damage to the rear
of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of Driver 2's vehicle that lines up with the reported point and direction of impact. No
prior damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was noted during the inspection. Driver 1 is listed as the named isnured
on the policy covering the vehicle. Officers observed Passenger in the vehilce immediately after the collision and
confirmed their presence with both drivers.
